text:
Anya: ran a regional sweep this morning for embed+rerank perf, posting quick notes. eu-west-1 (G5), ap-southeast-1 (A10), and c6a-large CPU baseline. dims: 1024/1536/2048, bs: 1/4/8/16, quant: fp16 and int8.
Matt G: awesome — any big surprises?
Anya: tail latency on ap-southeast-1 G5 was worse than we expected at bs=1 for 2048, 95p ~ 210ms vs eu ~ 150ms. throughput at bs=8 flips: ap region slightly better for int8 due to newer drivers.
Sree: do we have kernel variants logged? nvfuser vs cuBLAS/cuDNN?
Anya: yes — nvfuser enabled on G5 in eu, but AP run used default kernels. I included kernel tags in the run ids.
Anya: bench command we used:\n```\npython bench_runner.py --model rwr-v2-2048 --mode embed_rerank --dim 2048 --batch 8 --quant int8 --kernel nvfuser --warmup 50 --iters 500 --region eu-west-1\n```\nKai: can you paste the summarized csv or gist?
Anya: uploaded csv -> https://internal.gists/redwood/bench/1832105555 (private). short table inlined below.
BenchBot: AUTO: job 1832105555-run1 logs: finished 2023-11-12T09:12:10Z, p95=148ms, qps=320 (G5 eu, 2048, bs=8, int8)
Anya: inline summary (G5 eu / A10 ap / c6a cpu) for 2048 dim bs=8 int8: [p50/p95/qps]
Anya: G5 eu: 60ms / 148ms / 320 qps
Anya: A10 ap: 72ms / 210ms / 360 qps
Anya: c6a cpu: 180ms / 420ms / 45 qps
Matt G: interesting the AP qps > EU qps with higher p95. could be queuing/batching differences.
Sree: might be different batching window defaults at region-level. also check NUMA binding on AP hosts.
Anya: good call — AP hosts were running default kernel without cpuset pinning. I re-ran a small test with --numa-bind and p95 dropped to 160ms, qps unchanged.
Kai: what about smaller dims? 1024/1536?
Anya: 1024 bs=8 int8: G5 eu p95=88ms qps=620, A10 ap p95=95ms qps=640, cpu p95=220ms qps=70. 1536 sits in between as expected.
Sree: were you using prefix KV caching? that changes effective tail for rerank flows.
Anya: KV disabled for these runs to isolate kernel/hw perf. we'll run with cache next.
Matt G: any regressions between fp16 and int8 on quality?
Anya: quick eval on 500 holdout pairs: int8 top-1 match to fp16 ~ 98.6% for reranker logits — acceptable for most customers but flagged a few edge docs.
Kai: ops ask: capacity guidance for Dedicated — baseline for 2048 int8 is ~320 qps per G5 node (our config). recommend 3 nodes for 800 qps with headroom.
Infra SRE: noted — we should publish a node profile doc with driver/kernel requirements + cpuset recommendations.
Anya: follow-ups: 1) rerun AP with nvfuser and cpuset pinned 2) run with KV cache on 3) produce a perf chart (p50/p95/qps) across dims and bs. I'll open a ticket.
Sree: I can help with the nvfuser flags and trace collection.
Matt G: thanks — can we aim to share slides for next eng-ml sync? 1 slide per region + node profile.
Anya: yep, will draft. tl;dr: GPU >> CPU for throughput; int8 gives big qps boost w/ small quality hit; region/kernel/NUMA configs materially affect tail latency.
Kai: :thumbsup:
Matt G: great work, thanks!
